entries.speaker: Nanami
entries.en: Sorry for the sudden call![n]It's Shibuya, from the store.

entries.speaker: Nanami
entries.en: I was wondering if you had[n]time to come in today?

entries.speaker: Nanami
entries.en: It's a double-points day[n]for cardholders, so we're[n]getting kinda slammed.

entries.speaker: Nanami
entries.en: If you could help out, I'd[n]really appreciate it!

entries.speaker: Nanami
entries.en: Oh, right! And the manager[n]said you'll get paid extra[n]for really busy days!

entries.speaker: Nanami
entries.en: It's fine if you can't, but[n]if you've got the time,[n]please come help out!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So there'll be a lot of people there?[n]Might be a good chance to practice[n]your [stIcon 1][clr 26][stLabel 1][clr 27] too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And you'll even get bonus pay. Might[n]be worth considering...
